add_background_noise: add background noise or white noise to an audio file with a configurable signal-to-noise ratio in dB
pitch_shift: shift the pitch of an audio clip up or down by a given number of semitone steps
time_stretch: speed up or slow down an audio clip by a fixed rate without changing its pitch
reverb: add reverberation effects to audio with configurable room scale, damping, stereo depth, and wet gain
fft_convolve: apply FFT-based convolution to audio using a custom impulse response or random impulse as the filter
